posture: This is the entertainment evidence hunt: start with the highest-yield visual, social, forum, blog, complaint, Spanish-language, and competitor searches, then preserve the strongest sourced findings for human review before anything becomes client-facing.

queryPacks.why: Most likely place to see current guest-shot shows, pool activities, nightlife energy, and dead-air moments.
Best visual cross-check for promoted entertainment versus what guests actually post and tag.
Long-form videos reveal real venue layout, crowd energy, show quality, and whether entertainment is memorable enough to film.
Recent, highly specific traveler Q&A often surfaces exact show/activity complaints before they hit review platforms.
Unfiltered comparison language and “would I return?” discussions are ideal for finding the buried negative or rave.
Long-form reviews often include day-by-day descriptions that review boxes truncate.
Low volume, high severity. Useful for recurring entertainment failures, misleading marketing, or kid-program safety complaints.
Mexico/Caribbean resorts often have Spanish guest commentary that English-only review sweeps miss.
Finds guests comparing entertainment against nearby resorts, which is often more useful than isolated sentiment.
